name: ALLY 35 – KI-Verbrauch
description: Unterablauf der neuen Oberfläche (BA5): KI-Verbrauch des Monats (Kennzahlen, Kosten je Funktion). Liefert nur JSON (Seitenbeschreibung).

parameters.query:
SELECT s.person IS NOT NULL AS ok, coalesce(s.rolle = 'admin' AND ally_hat_recht(s.person, 'admin'), false) AS admin,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN ki_monat_stand() END AS stand,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN ki_monat_funktionen() END AS funktionen,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT to_char(min(zeit) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM.YYYY') FROM ki_verbrauch) END AS seit,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT jsonb_build_object('budget_modus', v.budget_modus, 'warn_prozent', v.warn_prozent, 'spar_prozent', v.spar_prozent) FROM plattform_vertrag v WHERE v.id = 1) END AS vertrag,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(z.schluessel, z.wert), '{}'::jsonb) FROM ally_ui_zustand z
    WHERE z.person = s.person AND split_part(z.schluessel, '.', 1) = 'ki-verbrauch') END AS zustand
FROM (SELECT 1) x LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM ally_ui_sitzung($1::text) y WHERE NOT y.muss_pw_setzen) s ON true;
